references.text: In Matthew 18:2–6, Jesus uses a child as an example of those who are greatest in the kingdom of heaven, showing his love and care for children, parallel to the event in Matthew 19:13.
Mark 10:13–16 describes a similar event where Jesus blesses the children, which directly corresponds with the event in Matthew 19:13.
Luke 18:15–17 also tells of Jesus blessing the children, which is a parallel event to Matthew 19:13.
